separateEffects.Structure removal: Remove one occurrence from a new Structure revision. Retain its previous revision and target Work/content; do not withdraw publication, qualification or Realm placement.
separateEffects.qualification withdrawal: End the exact resource/variant qualification head. Keep the Content publication decision and immutable revision. Other live publication support still authorizes its exact bytes.
separateEffects.Work publication withdrawal: Use the existing work-structure-publication-v1 operation=withdraw; end that Work decision's instruction adoption support. Do not remove occurrences or change other qualifications.
separateEffects.Realm placement withdrawal: End one author-owned Realm/reply placement head. Keep reply identity, author, root coordinates, exact revisions and independently authorized placements in other Realms. This is separate from moderation and erasure.

studioInventory.reuse: Extend existing Studio read, item, private source-position fence and authority checks; no separate search endpoint or client filtering.

parameters.agent: Path UUID of the controlled acting Agent. This is the acting identity; no second actingSubject query parameter.
parameters.q: Optional title substring, maximum 200 Unicode scalar values. Normalize NFKC, trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase without a locale; empty or omitted means all titles. Apply to the authorized inventory before ordering and pagination. Search no body, author name or description. Content language and UI locale do not change matching.
parameters.sort: Optional enum recent|created|title, default recent. recent orders updatedAt descending; created orders createdAt descending; title orders NFKC lowercase title ascending by Unicode scalar values. Full native Work IRI ascending breaks every tie. Stable across pages and repeated reads of an unchanged basis.
parameters.state: Reuse optional empty|draft|published; omitted includes all states.
parameters.type: Reuse optional full https://schema.org/Book, DigitalDocument or Recipe IRI; omitted includes supported types.
parameters.view: Reuse authored|curated, default authored. This decision does not redefine curated or grant author actions through curation.
parameters.limit: Reuse integer 1..20, default 20; page size is part of the bound continuation.
parameters.cursor: Reuse opaque nonempty continuation up to 2048 characters. Bind normalized q, sort including defaults, state, type, view, limit, acting Agent, source basis and live authority basis. A changed query/filter/Agent/page size is 400 invalid_read. A moved valid source basis is 409 read_basis_changed. A caller without Agent control receives 403 before private cursor or inventory disclosure.

studioInventory.response: Reuse items/nextCursor/sourcePosition/count. count={value:items.length,kind:exact-page,total:null}; nextCursor=null terminates, including empty results. No fabricated whole-inventory total or new page-complete field.
studioInventory.chapterCount: Add required item.chapterCount to list and GET /v1/me/agents/{agent}/works/{id}. Book: {value:nonnegative integer,complete:boolean}; non-Book: null. Count active chapter occurrences across every nested group and continuation, not distinct targets or groups. Repeated placement of one chapter counts repeatedly. complete=false means an explicit lower bound, never an exact-looking zero. The small 23-occurrence corpus must be complete=true. Preserve the existing bounded chapters endpoint and exact-page counts; do not flatten its hierarchy.
studioInventory.authorization: Authenticated control of the path Agent. Realm membership, moderation and platform status confer no other author's Studio access. Another Agent controlled by the same Account has its own inventory and cursor binding.

reuse: POST /v1/content-drafts profile=content-text-v1 for existing chapter Work and Post resourceId/variantId, expectedHead=exact draft revision UUID
POST /v1/content-edits profile=metadata-only-v1 for existing native Work, expectedHead=full Work revision IRI
POST /v1/member-reply-drafts profile=member-reply-draft-v1 for existing reply/variantId/rootTarget/rootRevision, expectedHead=exact revision UUID
POST /v1/content-publications profile=content-publication-v1 with exact digest, Content epoch and expectedPublicationHead
POST /v1/content-search-eligibility profile=content-search-eligibility-v1 with the new publicationDecision and expectedEligibilityHead
POST /v1/realm-reply-placements profile=realm-reply-placement-v1 to advance the author's own direct placement to the exact corrected reply revision
correction.receipt: Content draft: same resourceId/variantId, new revisionId, predecessor=expectedHead, exact byteDigest, sourcePosition.owner=content and replayed=false. Reply draft: same reply/variantId, new revisionId/revisionDigest, predecessor=expectedHead, replayed=false. Exact-reader reference.byteDigest is SHA-256 of serializedJson UTF-8 bytes and equals the acknowledged byteDigest (revisionDigest for a reply); exact reference retains author and predecessor. Metadata: same work, new revision, predecessor=expectedHead. Successful identical-key retry is 200 with the identical receipt and replayed=true; fresh-key stale head or changed intent under the same key is 409. No replacement Work, Post or reply identity is created.
correction.publicTransition: Saving a draft does not publish it or replace current public bytes. Republish and qualify the exact new Content revision, or place the exact corrected reply revision. Historical exact author reads retain bytes and attribution. A superseded Post revision with no independent support is unavailable to an anonymous reader; the original chapter revision remains public through a separately published Recipe instruction adoption.
correction.exactHistoryRead: Reuse GET /v1/content-revisions/{revisionUUID}?actingSubject={nativeAgentIRI} and GET /v1/revisions/{workRevisionUUID}?actingSubject={nativeAgentIRI}. Explicitly extend the Content exact reader's existing resource resolution to retained member-reply revisions. Public reply exact bytes require an active placement for that exact revision; author private history uses existing Account/Access authority and retained author provenance even after placement withdrawal. Unknown or unauthorized private exact revisions are 404. This extension adds no independent history store, publication authority or erase bypass.
correction.identityAndRights: Original contribution provenance retains the creating Person. Reply rootTarget/rootRevision, parent and origin Realm coordinates are immutable. A correction does not borrow membership, moderator or operator powers. All normal rights, disclosure, restrictions and erasure checks continue.

request.publicationDecision: full IRI of the exact publication supported by this qualification
request.expectedEligibilityHead: non-null full IRI of the active qualification being withdrawn
request.actingSubject: full native Agent IRI; controls and owns the selected qualification, under existing live authority

receipt201.decision: new immutable withdrawal decision native IRI, now the eligibility head

qualificationWithdrawal.recovery: Bearer and Idempotency-Key required. Identical intent/key returns 200 and the original acknowledged target even after withdrawal, replayed=true. Fresh key with the obsolete expectedEligibilityHead returns 409 stale_eligibility_head. Reusing a key for a changed publication/resource/variant/expected head returns 409 idempotency_conflict without another effect. Missing authentication=401; authenticated non-owner=403. No grant, re-qualification, unrelated publication or target deletion substitutes for withdrawal.
qualificationWithdrawal.refresh: Existing content-variants read retains publicationHead unchanged and exposes eligibilityHead equal to receipt.decision. Exact retained author read remains available. Public read depends on independent live support for that exact revision.

request.expectedHead: non-null full IRI of this Realm/reply's active placement
request.expectedRevisionId: UUID of that exact placed revision
request.actingSubject: full native Agent IRI owning this direct author placement

receipt201.withdrawal: new immutable native IRI, now the placement head

placementWithdrawal.recovery: Bearer and Idempotency-Key required. Identical key/intent returns 200 with the same acknowledgement and replayed=true. Obsolete placement head or a revision mismatch is 409 realm_reply_stale; changed intent/key reuse is 409 idempotency_conflict. Missing authentication=401; authenticated non-owner=403. Owning a reply alone does not confer withdrawal authority over another publisher's placement, even in another Realm. Owning the Realm alone does not turn another author's direct placement into this operation; use existing moderation separately.
placementWithdrawal.refresh: GET /v1/realms/{realm}/replies/{reply} no longer exposes the withdrawn placement (404). Independently authorized other-Realm placement, another author's reply, canonical identity, exact author history and author attribution remain unchanged.
